price.text_ja: 掲載価格 USD 49（購入時に公式で確認）
price.text_en: Listed price USD 39 (standard price announced 5 Oct 2026). Add-ons (90% split and On-Demand Payouts at 25% of the base price each, Weekend Holding at 15%) cost extra. Confirm the final amount at checkout.

funded_profit_target.text_ja: 初回出金には6%の確定利益が必要。5利益日・一貫性条件も適用。
funded_profit_target.text_en: The first payout requires 6% closed profit; the 20% consistency rule also applies. The five-profitable-days requirement before the first payout was removed (announced 5 Oct 2026; effective date not stated). Application to existing accounts is unconfirmed.

ea.text_ja: 日本向け現行案内はThinkTrader。対応する第三者自動化は事前にサポートへ連絡し、必要に応じファイル等を提出。MT5の標準EA対応とは異なる。

sources.evidence_scope: Japanese current platform and automation scope batch193

ea.text_en: Current Japan guidance uses ThinkTrader. Contact support in advance about supported third-party automation and provide files if required. Not standard MT5 EA support.

payout_interval.text_ja: 公開規約では初取引から14暦日後に初回申請。5利益日・6%確定利益・一貫性条件も必要。次回期間は承認翌日から起算。
payout_interval.text_en: Standard 14-day cycle (first request 14 calendar days after the first trade). Requires 6% closed profit and the 20% consistency rule. The paid On-Demand Payouts add-on (25% of the base price) lets you request without waiting for the cycle (it does not mean instant payment). Removal of the five-profitable-days requirement: announced 5 Oct 2026, effective date not stated. Application to existing accounts is unconfirmed.

payout_limit.text_ja: 最低出金 USD 100。 公開規約では月間の累計出金上限なし。ただし最低出金額・各サイクルの資格条件・一貫性・DD条件は適用。

sources.evidence_scope: Live terms section 7.6.5, monthly aggregate cap only; not per-request maximum

payout_limit.text_en: Minimum payout USD100. Published terms state no monthly cumulative cap, but minimums, cycle eligibility, consistency and DD apply.

leverage.text_ja: 最大50倍、動的レバレッジ。

consistency.text_ja: Boltは最高利益日が累計利益の20%以下。超える場合は追加利益で条件を満たしてから出金申請。
consistency.text_en: Bolt: best-day profit must be ≤20% of cumulative profit. If exceeded, earn enough additional profit before requesting payout.

daily_dd.text_ja: 日次損失上限3%（2026年10月5日の公式記事で「変更なし」と記載）。計算基準の詳細は公式Bolt規約で確認。
daily_dd.text_en: Daily loss limit 3% (stated as unchanged in the official 5 Oct 2026 article). Check the official Bolt rules for how it is calculated.

max_dd.text_ja: 最大損失上限6%（2026年10月5日の公式記事で「変更なし」と記載）。計算方法（固定・トレーリング）は公式Bolt規約で確認。
max_dd.text_en: Maximum loss limit 6% (stated as unchanged in the official 5 Oct 2026 article). Check the official Bolt rules for the calculation method (static or trailing).

profit_share.text_ja: 基本80%。有料アドオン（基本価格の25%）で90%（2026年10月5日導入）。
profit_share.text_en: Standard 80%; 90% with the paid add-on (25% of the base price), introduced 5 Oct 2026.

special_rules.title: Example of excessive-scalping assessment
special_rules.text: More than 50 of 100 trades lasting under 60 seconds is an example of assessment, not a universal average-time rule or assurance that 50% or less is safe.

price.text_ja: 掲載価格 USD 89（購入時に公式で確認）
price.text_en: Listed price USD 71 (standard price announced 5 Oct 2026). Add-ons (90% split and On-Demand Payouts at 25% of the base price each, Weekend Holding at 15%) cost extra. Confirm the final amount at checkout.

funded_profit_target.text_ja: 初回出金には6%の確定利益が必要。5利益日・一貫性条件も適用。
funded_profit_target.text_en: The first payout requires 6% closed profit; the 20% consistency rule also applies. The five-profitable-days requirement before the first payout was removed (announced 5 Oct 2026; effective date not stated). Application to existing accounts is unconfirmed.

ea.text_ja: 日本向け現行案内はThinkTrader。対応する第三者自動化は事前にサポートへ連絡し、必要に応じファイル等を提出。MT5の標準EA対応とは異なる。

sources.evidence_scope: Japanese current platform and automation scope batch193

ea.text_en: Current Japan guidance uses ThinkTrader. Contact support in advance about supported third-party automation and provide files if required. Not standard MT5 EA support.

payout_interval.text_ja: 公開規約では初取引から14暦日後に初回申請。5利益日・6%確定利益・一貫性条件も必要。次回期間は承認翌日から起算。
payout_interval.text_en: Standard 14-day cycle (first request 14 calendar days after the first trade). Requires 6% closed profit and the 20% consistency rule. The paid On-Demand Payouts add-on (25% of the base price) lets you request without waiting for the cycle (it does not mean instant payment). Removal of the five-profitable-days requirement: announced 5 Oct 2026, effective date not stated. Application to existing accounts is unconfirmed.

payout_limit.text_ja: 最低出金 USD 100。 公開規約では月間の累計出金上限なし。ただし最低出金額・各サイクルの資格条件・一貫性・DD条件は適用。

sources.evidence_scope: Live terms section 7.6.5, monthly aggregate cap only; not per-request maximum

payout_limit.text_en: Minimum payout USD100. Published terms state no monthly cumulative cap, but minimums, cycle eligibility, consistency and DD apply.

leverage.text_ja: 最大50倍、動的レバレッジ。

consistency.text_ja: Boltは最高利益日が累計利益の20%以下。超える場合は追加利益で条件を満たしてから出金申請。
consistency.text_en: Bolt: best-day profit must be ≤20% of cumulative profit. If exceeded, earn enough additional profit before requesting payout.

daily_dd.text_ja: 日次損失上限3%（2026年10月5日の公式記事で「変更なし」と記載）。計算基準の詳細は公式Bolt規約で確認。
daily_dd.text_en: Daily loss limit 3% (stated as unchanged in the official 5 Oct 2026 article). Check the official Bolt rules for how it is calculated.

max_dd.text_ja: 最大損失上限6%（2026年10月5日の公式記事で「変更なし」と記載）。計算方法（固定・トレーリング）は公式Bolt規約で確認。
max_dd.text_en: Maximum loss limit 6% (stated as unchanged in the official 5 Oct 2026 article). Check the official Bolt rules for the calculation method (static or trailing).

profit_share.text_ja: 基本80%。有料アドオン（基本価格の25%）で90%（2026年10月5日導入）。
profit_share.text_en: Standard 80%; 90% with the paid add-on (25% of the base price), introduced 5 Oct 2026.

special_rules.title: Example of excessive-scalping assessment
special_rules.text: More than 50 of 100 trades lasting under 60 seconds is an example of assessment, not a universal average-time rule or assurance that 50% or less is safe.

ea.text_en: Current Japan guidance uses ThinkTrader. Contact support in advance about supported third-party automation and provide files if required. Not standard MT5 EA support.

payout_interval.text_ja: 公開規約では初取引から14暦日後に初回申請。5利益日・6%確定利益・一貫性条件も必要。次回期間は承認翌日から起算。
payout_interval.text_en: Standard 14-day cycle (first request 14 calendar days after the first trade). Requires 6% closed profit and the 20% consistency rule. The paid On-Demand Payouts add-on (25% of the base price) lets you request without waiting for the cycle (it does not mean instant payment). Removal of the five-profitable-days requirement: announced 5 Oct 2026, effective date not stated. Application to existing accounts is unconfirmed.

payout_limit.text_ja: 最低出金 USD 100。 公開規約では月間の累計出金上限なし。ただし最低出金額・各サイクルの資格条件・一貫性・DD条件は適用。

sources.evidence_scope: Live terms section 7.6.5, monthly aggregate cap only; not per-request maximum

payout_limit.text_en: Minimum payout USD100. Published terms state no monthly cumulative cap, but minimums, cycle eligibility, consistency and DD apply.

leverage.text_ja: 最大50倍、動的レバレッジ。

consistency.text_ja: Boltは最高利益日が累計利益の20%以下。超える場合は追加利益で条件を満たしてから出金申請。
consistency.text_en: Bolt: best-day profit must be ≤20% of cumulative profit. If exceeded, earn enough additional profit before requesting payout.

daily_dd.text_ja: 日次損失上限3%（2026年10月5日の公式記事で「変更なし」と記載）。計算基準の詳細は公式Bolt規約で確認。
daily_dd.text_en: Daily loss limit 3% (stated as unchanged in the official 5 Oct 2026 article). Check the official Bolt rules for how it is calculated.

max_dd.text_ja: 最大損失上限6%（2026年10月5日の公式記事で「変更なし」と記載）。計算方法（固定・トレーリング）は公式Bolt規約で確認。
max_dd.text_en: Maximum loss limit 6% (stated as unchanged in the official 5 Oct 2026 article). Check the official Bolt rules for the calculation method (static or trailing).

profit_share.text_ja: 基本80%。有料アドオン（基本価格の25%）で90%（2026年10月5日導入）。
profit_share.text_en: Standard 80%; 90% with the paid add-on (25% of the base price), introduced 5 Oct 2026.

special_rules.title: Example of excessive-scalping assessment
special_rules.text: More than 50 of 100 trades lasting under 60 seconds is an example of assessment, not a universal average-time rule or assurance that 50% or less is safe.
